content.cn:
v26.0.5 正式版现已发布，Web、Electron 与 Tauri 版本同步更新。

本次更新包含：

- 全新的抽奖模式、加权轮盘、人员奖品分配、奖品单管理与独立抽奖记录
- 人员名单及其小组绑定支持 CSV/JSON 导入导出，导入时自动识别格式，默认导出 CSV
- 多人点名布局与启动性能优化，大量结果保持统一行列基线并避让控制区
- Fluent Tabs、智能自定义主题配色、Windows Fluent 主题、自动停止与多种结果强调动画
- UUID 人员身份记录与更可靠的历史记录
- 管理员计划任务自启动、启动到托盘、下载源选择及多项桌面稳定性修复

桌面安装包可在 GitHub Releases 下载。如遇异常，请通过 GitHub Issues 反馈。
content.en:
v26.0.5 is now available for Web, Electron, and Tauri.

This release adds the complete lottery workflow, weighted wheel, person-to-prize assignment, prize-list management and records; automatic CSV/JSON name-list import with group bindings; improved large-result layout and startup performance; Fluent tabs and generated themes; UUID-based identity records; auto stop and result animations; elevated scheduled-task startup, startup to tray, selectable download sources, and desktop stability fixes.

Desktop installers are available from GitHub Releases. Please report issues through GitHub Issues.
